loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A, while close in score, relies on inverse‑error weights that can over‑emphasize a few low‑error models and may be more sensitive to the high variance in weight estimation from only three windows. Candidate C, though using a pooled‑meta‑model, includes the full pool and shows higher per‑window errors, especially in the second window, indicating less robustness to the unstable ranking observed in the diagnosis.
